text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the New Year's holiday, but instead of resting, King Halo and I are training as usual.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hm? I wonder what that commotion is.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's lottery! This year's grand-prize is a coupon for a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: You two over there! Care to try your luck?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ooh, those prizes don't sound half bad.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Especially the hot spring coupon. I bet it's for a first-rate relaxation facility.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Did you forget who you're talking to? I'm a first-rate Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It's only natural I should know a thing or two about it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: So, then… Trainer…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm giving you the right to win a special prize on my behalf! And I expect you to put your heart in it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I feel her gaze fixed expectantly on me as I make a purchase to get a raffle ticket.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It might be on her behalf, but I'm still the one who's paying.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You only get one chance, Trainer! Crank that spinner with all your strength and win me the special prize!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo's trademark laughter echoes behind me as I turn the handle of the raffle spinner until a ball drops out.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's amazing! Even you can do a good job when you put your mind to it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll take that hot spring coupon, thank you very much! ♪ Excellent work, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo snatches the hot spring coupon and tucks it in her pocket.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Now I have one more thing to look forward to!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You mean our hot spring coupon.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Right now, we're both far too busy.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Even if we go somewhere and relax our bodies right now, our minds won't be fully at ease.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm going to invite you only after everything is finished and settled.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I guess she is planning to invite me on the hot spring trip eventually.
choice_data_list: You should've told me earlier then.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh? Is there a problem?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm the one holding the coupon, you know. You might want to watch that attitude.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: For instance, the first words coming out of your mouth ought to be "Thank you!" That's not unreasonable, right? Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A feeling of dread begins to creep in. Perhaps I've given her too much power.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Regardless, I'm looking forward to spending a full day just unwinding and relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Well, first place isn't bad either.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That deluxe carrot hamburger steak was made by the chef of a five-star hotel. The taste is also first-rate.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm sure I've told you this before, but I'm a first-rate Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It's only natural I should know a thing or two about it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes. I had it served fresh at a their restaurant.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It was scrumptious. The way the tomato sauce and juices ooze out when you bite down, along with that rich cheese…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Gulp.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's go back to the academy at once! I'm giving you the right to prepare my dinner!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She looks ready to wolf down an entire restaurant. We return to the academy and I prepare the hamburger steak immediately.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What should I… even say?
choice_data_list: It's certainly a lot of carrots.
It's certainly a lot of carrots.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the clerk continues to pile carrot after carrot on top of the already monstrous heap, King Halo grows anxious.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: There's still more! I wasn't lying about the mountain part!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Eep! You can't be serious!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: They keep adding more…
choice_data_list: We'll have to make a few trips to bring them all back.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah… Let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several trips later, we finally manage to bring the bushel of carrots back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When we finally finish eating our giant supply, I give King Halo a high five of relief.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: One carrot… One. Single. Carrot? Where's the luxurious prize I asked you for?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: This is only good for a post-workout juice!
choice_data_list: (Well, at least she knows how to prepare it.)
(Well, at least she knows how to prepare it.)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Trainer, make yourself useful and put this in the blender for me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Let's hurry back to the academy. I expect some good juice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Upon our return, I blend up the carrot and serve her some freshly made carrot juice.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Trainer, don't worry. I'll simply pretend I didn't see anything.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Now, let's try again. I'll keep my eyes closed. Off you go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, we could only try once with our single lottery ticket. I manage to pacify her on the way back to the academy.
